name: Blinding Assault
blurb: Active:  Quinn sends  Valor in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing physical damage all nearby enemies.

effects.description: Active: Quinn sends Valor in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, marking them with Harrier and dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies, increased to 200% against monsters.
The primary target is nearsighted for 1.75 seconds if they are a champion, and disarmed for the same duration otherwise.

notes:
Blinding Assault's  nearsight will persist through  death.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
